narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -6.13 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.003631-0.003668 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.003877; the first objective pays 1.14R at 0.003547.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.003877 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: 3-TF alignment incomplete AND no absorption/CVD-divergence at the zone (3-TF: H4 13×89 trend · H1 structure against · m15 bar lost EMA89)
